checks: DC gain and initialized steady state
energy per bit and draw-return identity
independent delayed ideal NRZ zero-error control
known latency retained, not validation retuned
ideal horizontal eye around frozen phase
detail.scope: analytical code controls, not electrical/optical circuit validation
declared simulation case lists and nominal grid only; not physical/optical/product qualification

prior_diagnostic_run.status: excluded from final completion and failure counts
prior_diagnostic_run.scope: deliberately interrupted r3 C cases retained; no r3 RC transient was run

scope: hash/provenance, coverage, actual terminal-vector and outcome consistency; not LVS, extraction validation, BER or signoff
